title: Learn Darija Basics: Key Phrases for Every Traveler
description: Start speaking Moroccan Darija with the essential phrases you need for travel, food, and local conversation.
excerpt: Master essential Darija travel phrases for greetings, food ordering, and everyday conversations in Morocco.
content:
Moroccan Darija is a living language shaped by history, food, and daily life. Start with these practical expressions to connect quickly with locals:

🔹 Greetings and polite phrases

  • Salam 3likom — Hello / Peace be upon you.
  • Labas? — How are you?
  • Shukran — Thank you.

🔹 Ask for directions

  • Fin kayn ...? — Where is ...?
  • Bsh7al? — How much?
  • 3afak — Please.

Use these phrases with a friendly smile and you'll build instant rapport with shopkeepers, drivers, and hosts.

title: Must-Know Moroccan Food Words for a Great Meal
description: Navigate souks and menus with confidence by learning the most important Darija food words and ordering tips.
excerpt: Learn the Moroccan Darija food vocabulary that makes eating at a market, restaurant, or cafe easier and more fun.
content:
Eating in Morocco is a joyful experience. These key words help you order and explore the best dishes without confusion.

🍲 Common food words

  • Ta3am — Food
  • Atay — Tea
  • Khobz — Bread

🧾 Ordering phrases

  • Bghit ... — I want ...
  • Mashi bzzaf — Not too much.
  • Za3ma — Really?

With these words, your market meals become part of the story rather than a stressful task.
